tax_profiles_rates_check.name: tax_profiles_rates_check
tax_profiles_rates_check.value:
("tax_profiles"."vat_status" = 'VAT' AND "tax_profiles"."vat_rate" > 0 AND "tax_profiles"."vat_rate" < 1 AND "tax_profiles"."percentage_tax_rate" = 0)
       OR ("tax_profiles"."vat_status" = 'NON_VAT' AND "tax_profiles"."vat_rate" = 0 AND "tax_profiles"."percentage_tax_rate" >= 0 AND "tax_profiles"."percentage_tax_rate" < 1)

cash_movements_sign_check.name: cash_movements_sign_check
cash_movements_sign_check.value: ("cash_movements"."type" = 'PAY_OUT' AND "cash_movements"."amount" < 0) OR ("cash_movements"."type" IN ('PAY_IN') AND "cash_movements"."amount" > 0) OR ("cash_movements"."type" IN ('OPENING_FLOAT','SALE') AND "cash_movements"."amount" >= 0)

stock_movements_sale_link.name: stock_movements_sale_link
stock_movements_sale_link.value: ("stock_movements"."type" = 'SALE') = ("stock_movements"."sale_line_id" IS NOT NULL AND "stock_movements"."sale_id" IS NOT NULL)
